svg.title: A B-cell lineage with shared and later somatic mutations
svg.desc: A synthetic unmutated sequence, GCTGACTTTGGACAATAC, changes at position 4 from G to A before the most recent common ancestor of the four sampled variants. One branch gains T to C at position 9, then splits into A1 with T to C at position 3 and A2 with T to A at position 7. The other gains A to G at position 14, then splits into B1 with T to A at position 16 and B2 with G to A at position 11. Aligned sequences show the same changes. All four descendants retain the shared position-4 mutation; their consensus therefore differs from the unmutated starting sequence.
svg.text: A shared history leaves a pattern of mutations
The sampled family’s most recent common ancestor can already differ from its pre-SHM ancestor.
All descendants carry A at position 4.
A tip consensus would retain this acquired change.
Dating requires a separate rate model.
Synthetic coding fragment and genealogy. Local nucleotide positions; one substitution per labelled edge.
